description: This file defines interfaces and abstract classes for broadcast channel subscribers in an Orleans-based testing environment, including concrete implementations with specific subscription attributes.

classes.name: SubscriberGrainBase
classes.description: An abstract base class implementing common broadcast channel subscription logic, including error handling and message processing.

classes.name: SimpleSubscriberGrain
classes.description: A concrete implementation of SubscriberGrainBase with implicit channel subscription attribute.

classes.name: RegexNamespaceSubscriberGrain
classes.description: A concrete implementation of SubscriberGrainBase with regex-based channel subscription attribute.

methods.name: GetErrors
methods.description: Retrieves the list of errors associated with a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves the list of integer values associated with a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetOnPublishedCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of how many times the OnPublished method has been invoked.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles subscription to a broadcast channel, attaching message and error handlers.

methods.name: ThrowsOnReceive
methods.description: Sets whether the grain should throw an exception upon receiving a message.
